# Locora AI — AI Business Operating System & Local SEO Copilot

> Locora AI (https://locoraai.com) is an AI business-growth platform that helps local businesses get found on Google and cited by AI assistants like ChatGPT. It combines a free AI visibility checkup, local SEO tooling, review management, CRM, proposals and invoicing in one workspace. Pricing: Free Explorer plan; Pro Growth $29/mo; Agency Elite $99/mo.

## Start Here
- Free AI Visibility Checkup (40-point scan of Google, Maps and AI visibility — no signup or credit card to see the score): https://locoraai.com/checkup
- For Dentists (AI visibility checkup for dental practices): https://locoraai.com/for/dentists
- Sample Dental Checkup Report (illustrative sample for a fictional practice): https://locoraai.com/for/dentists/sample-report
